name: Godfrey Phillips India Limited
remarksWeb: Foreign Ownership approved limits break-up is as under: i. Foreign Direct Investment (FDI): 25.10% - Please note that as per Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules, 2019 (Rules), FDI is prohibited in the Company, as it is primarily engaged into manufacturing of cigarettes. Further, the Company has been operating since 1936 and one of the Promoters of the Company, being Foreign Body Corporate, holds 25.1% equity share capital of the Company, in terms of relevant permissions obtained, prior to the said prohibition in FDI coming into place. ii. Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI): 24.00% - As per the Rules, the aggregate limit is 24%. iii. Non-Resident Indian (NRI) or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) on repatriation basis: 10.00% - As per the Rules, the total holdings of all NRIs and OCIs, put together, shall not exceed 10% of the total paid up equity capital. The aggregate ceiling may be raised to 24% if special resolution is passed. Please note that the Company has not passed any special resolution, hence the limits continue to be 10%.
